Name: give elliott his earring back. it's what he deserves
Author: uwugothgf
Description:
does what it says on the tin! based on elliott's earlier sprites seen [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/eb/Elliott_Timeline.png]here[/url]

this is my first-ever stardew valley mod so i can't promise it won't break your game somehow. always always ALWAYS [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Saves#Back_up_or_transfer_between_two_PCs]back up your saves[/url] before you use mods!

not compatible with other mods that change elliott's portrait. requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=description]SMAPI[/url]
